decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks sit squarely in the firm's thermoforming and dental-laboratory expertise and have a page of their own, so in-house R&D can readily interpret results and refine the line.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a direct extension of the firm's core materials knowledge for dental labs and is prominently presented, so the firm is well placed to learn from it and keep it.

UV-curing lacquer builds on the firm's light-curing materials and custom-device finishing know-how, though it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests lower prominence and a somewhat higher risk of being dropped.

Intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's digital scanning and manufacturing workflow, which the firm knows well, and it has its own page, although it lies slightly further from core manufacturing.
Custom earmolds are core skilled custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, so the firm can absorb feedback and improve the line through its own R&D.
Custom hearing protection earmolds rely on the same impression-to-shell custom manufacturing knowledge as the earmold business, which makes them a related extension worth keeping.
